maria: Quick check — onboarding weights for falconx-40b-extended are in s3://redwood-models/falconx/40b-ext/v1 (sha: 3a2f9d). Does anyone have a quick validation for max context / KV cache layout? We want to run a Dedicated canary at 32k and want to avoid surprises.

alex: Which exact path for tokenizer? I can run a tokenization smoke test.

maria: tokenizer is in s3://redwood-models/falconx/40b-ext/v1/tokenizer.json and merges.json. weights at s3://redwood-models/falconx/40b-ext/v1/weights.pt

kevin: heads-up — our tokenizer pipeline has added an extra  token in some exports before. That can push token_count +1 in edge cases. Recommend we assume an off-by-one and leave a small headroom on max_ctx.

kevin: quick check you can run locally:
```
python - <<'PY'
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
t = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('path/to/tokenizer')
print(len(t.encode('Hello world')))
PY
```

jin: KV cache format for this family is the usual shape: (layers, 2, heads, seq_len, head_dim). Note: we've seen torch.load(...) materialize the full KV onto CPU first and OOM when seq_len is large. Use our peek helper or map_location to avoid that.

jin: recommended commands:
```
# peek shape without full materialization
python scripts/load_kv.py --file /tmp/weights.kv.pt --peek-shape
```

alex: Also remember quantization helps weight memory but KV still drives peak for long contexts. Rough calc: KV_mem ~= seq_len * hidden_size * 2 * layers * bytes_per_element (bytes depends on dtype). For fp16 that's ~2 bytes/elem. Keep margin.

maria: Proposed onboarding defaults: max_context=32768, max_kv_seq=32760 (leave small headroom), default_batch=1. @kevin can you run the mem sim and paste peak numbers?

kevin: on it. running: `tests/mem_sim.py --model falconx-40b-extended --seq 32768 --bs 1 --dtype float16`. ETA ~6m :hourglass:

infra-bot: Scheduled canary run on dedicated-west (1x A100) in 10m — job id 87921.

jin: I'll open a micro-PR to fix the tokenizer mapping that caused the extra token (PR #5123). Should land in CI and then we can re-export assets.

maria: great. If kevin sees >85% GPU mem we reduce max_kv_seq to 30720 for the canary. Otherwise we'll proceed with 32760.

kevin: first sim result: peak ~78% of GPU mem. second run with tiny padding showed ~81% peak. raw log: `peak_mem=41.3GB / 52.0GB` so we're within margin.

maria: perfect — marking model onboarding as ready-for-dedicated-canary and updating checklist. :white_check_mark: If PR #5123 lands, remember to re-run fasttokenizer export before the canary.

alex: nice. I'll add a short note in the model catalog: "max_kv_seq set with safety margin; tokenizer PR pending".

kevin: leaving a small note: when running local experiments, set `TORCH_SHOW_CPP_STACKTRACES=1` if you hit weird OOMs — often it's the loader triggering a copy.

maria: thanks all. follow-ups: kevin -> attach sim logs to the onboarding ticket, jin -> small tokenizer PR, alex -> add catalog note, infra -> run canary as scheduled.
